# Classical Optimal Liquidation {#plan-ch09}

::: {.planned-chapter}
Source draft
:::

Derives the basic cost-risk trade-off and uses it to explain the shape of an optimal liquidation schedule.

**Subtopics.** Discrete and continuous inventory dynamics; temporary impact; price risk; Bertsimas-Lo; Almgren-Chriss; expected cost and variance; the execution frontier; risk aversion and urgency; boundary conditions; closed-form trajectories; calibration; units and limiting cases; when the classical assumptions fail.
